title: Warby Parker Unveils First Intelligent Eyewear Design
summary: Rooted in the brand’s signature aesthetic, debut style balances elevated design with effortless, all-day wear Warby Parker Inc. (NYSE: WRBY), a lifestyle brand focused on vision for all, today unveiled its first Intelligent Eyewear frame designed for all-day, everyday wear. The debut style combines Warby Parker’s distinctive approach to design with Google’s leadership in AI and Samsung’s mobile leadership to create beautifully crafted eyewear that seamlessly enhances everyday life. For more than 16 years, Warby Parker has redefined how consumers shop for glasses by pairing meticulous, timeless design with exceptional customer experiences.
